scope: Actual ngspice run of resistor dividers and an IDEAL Q7 switch. DC/manual topology audit using current PCB pad nets. NO full-board or full UPS simulation.

current_firmware.pause_policy: Call/ringing/OTA only; not linked to battery percent. GPIO38 high disables CE through Q7.
current_firmware.boot_and_firmware_absent_hardware_defaul: R69 holds Q7 gate low; R68 pulls CE high. Charger itself uses normal 4.2V regulation subject to TEMP and other protections.
current_firmware.battery_absence_note: ADC alone cannot prove cell presence; unloaded BAT output/capacitors may have voltage. No valid battery percentage should be inferred without presence qualification.

charger.cell_required: Single-cell 4.2V rechargeable Li-ion/Li-polymer; cell charge-current and temperature limits must be matched. Not LiFePO4 or a 4.35V charging design.

NTC.pack_assumed: 10k B3950, referenced CELL_NEG; actual pack unknown
NTC.required_action: Recalculate resistor network for selected cell, conservatively inside its permitted charging-temperature range. Current nominal low threshold is below 0C.
NTC.short_NTC_note: TP4056-MS datasheet says TEMP tied to GND disables temperature monitoring. Do not claim an NTC short is automatically protected.

no_battery.path: J1 -> F1/Q6 -> VIN_PROTECTED -> U18 VIN1 -> SYS_5V -> U2 modem rail / U13 ESP rail; amp supplied SYS_5V. No battery in this series path.
no_battery.no_NTC_EXPECTED_behavior: TEMP remains above 80%VCC; charger suspended, independent external system path remains.
no_battery.verification_needed: Cold power-on with battery/NTC unplugged; loaded 4G attach/call/amp, disconnect/reconnect input, brownout and no spurious low-cell shutdown.

requirements: Filtering, hysteresis and charging/load-voltage correction; short relaxed measurement before resume
Pause charging when ADC calibration/sample invalid
Treat no battery as external-only, not empty/full battery
Retain hardware voltage/overcurrent/temperature protection independent of ESP
Boot fallback and reboot persistence; enforce policy before charger startup if a strict 80% cap is required
desired_80_70_policy.reason: Avoid prolonged high SOC for a standby backup cell; voltage-based percentage is approximate and not battery safety qualification.
